name: charselect_anim_period
description: Same navigation as title_to_character_select, but captures EVERY frame across a 130-frame window while parked on CHARACTER_SELECT. Purpose is not pixel fidelity -- it is measuring the ANIMATION RATE of the dancing characters against the real ROM. A reported bug says the dancing is far too fast in the browser build; comparing the bob period in frames, ares vs native, decides whether the engine advances menu animation too fast everywhere or only under the browser's pacing. Measured by tools/anim_period.py.
